description.text: A wide shot opens low over a burning battlefield, where a huge black dragon with a knight in battered plate armour on its back banks across the frame. The dragon's wings stretch wide, leathery membranes dark against the smoke, and its long neck cuts a line over flame and charred ground. Firelight catches the knight's dented plate, the visor raised enough to show his face as he leans forward in the saddle and shouts over the wind. Smoke drifts in long bands, distant siege lines glow through the haze, and the dragon sweeps low enough for the rush of air to flatten the grass. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, tightening on the pair as the battlefield opens beneath them.
A huge black dragon banks low over a burning battlefield, wings spread wide.
The knight in battered plate armour braces in the saddle and shouts over the wind.
Deep wingbeats, roaring fire, and wind rushing past armour fill the air.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

The shot cuts to a medium close view of the knight in battered plate armour, his visor up and firelight sliding across the dents and scratches in the metal. He braces against the saddle, one gauntleted hand locked on the reins, while the huge black dragon's scaled neck fills the background and its rumbling breath vibrates through the frame. Wind tears past, snapping at the knight's cloak and flattening the smoke into streaks. He looks down toward troops below, jaw set, but does not speak in this shot; the focus stays on the strain of the ride and the churn of the battle beneath. The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at fast speed, keeping the rider centered as the dragon's body shifts under him.
Medium close view of the knight in battered plate armour, visor up, firelight across dented plate.
The knight braces against the saddle and locks one gauntleted hand on the reins while the dragon's neck fills the background.
Wind tears past, armour clatters, and the dragon's rumbling breath vibrates through the frame.
Smoke streaks past and the dragon's scaled body shifts under the rider.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at fast speed.

The camera cuts back to a wide view as the huge black dragon pulls up sharply over a wall of fire, wings cupping the air and embers streaming past. The knight in battered plate armour leans into the climbing turn, keeping low against the saddle while the burning field falls away beneath them. Flame whooshes upward, smoke rolls outward, and the dragon's dark silhouette rises through the glow, its wingbeats heavy and deliberate. The camera arcs around the subject with small amplitude at slow speed, revealing the pair from the side as the climb carries them above the burning battlefield and toward the hazy sky.
The huge black dragon pulls up sharply over a wall of fire, wings cupping the air.
The knight in battered plate armour leans into the climbing turn and stays low against the saddle.
Heavy wingbeats, fire whooshing upward, and embers crackling fill the air.
The burning field falls away beneath the dragon as the pair climbs through smoke.
The camera arcs around the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.
